must_survive_generation.hair: Same length, parting, colour, and tie as CHARACTER_REFERENCE full_body views. Hair streams backward and upward under descent airflow; the hairline and silhouette stay identical.
must_survive_generation.body_proportions: Same height, build, shoulder-to-hip ratio, and head-to-body ratio as CHARACTER_REFERENCE full_body_front / full_body_side.
must_survive_generation.costume: Same garment set, cut, length, closure, colour, material, and wear state as COSTUME_REFERENCE. Robe panels and sleeves flutter with a lag behind body movement; the garment never changes design mid-shot.
must_survive_generation.symbolic_prop: One single sword, exactly the geometry, material, colour, guard shape, and identifying marks of SYMBOLIC_PROP_REFERENCE. Never duplicated, never re-coloured, never replaced.

scene.location: High altitude above and descending toward Thiên Kiếm Thành (Heavenly Sword City), a fortified xianxia mountain city.
scene.time_of_day: Late afternoon descending into dusk as altitude drops.
scene.weather: Broken cloud deck at mid-altitude; clear, cold air above; dense warm air and lantern light below.
scene.world_rules: Cultivation-world physics: a ridden sword flies and carries a standing rider. No modern technology, no modern materials, no vehicles, no power lines.
scene.art_direction_world_intent: Xianxia cultivation epic. Painted-cinematic realism: real atmospheric perspective, real cloud volume, real stone and timber city mass. Not anime-flat, not glossy game-render.
scene.scale_and_depth_cues: Cloud layers at three distinct depths; the city wall and gate grow from a silhouette to legible architecture across the shot; falling debris and mist streaks provide parallax.

per_beat.core_action: Rides the sword in a committed forward dive, weight pressed down through the balls of the feet, knees bent, torso angled into the descent.
per_beat.intention: He is arriving, not sightseeing — the descent is deliberate and urgent.
observable_signals: robe panels and wide sleeves stream backward with a visible lag behind the body
hair and ribbons lift and trail upward-backward under airflow
one hand lowered and slightly back for balance, fingers spread, not clenched
gaze fixed forward-down toward the city, head steady relative to the torso
small corrective weight shifts at the ankles as the descent steepens
per_beat.subtext: Confidence with a held breath — the city is bigger than he expected.

per_beat.core_action: Holds the same riding posture while the camera arcs; he does not re-pose for the camera.
per_beat.intention: The descent continues uninterrupted; the reveal is the camera's job, not his.
observable_signals: shoulders stay level, torso still angled into the fall
eyes track the gate ahead as the frontal view opens
robe and hair continue streaming in the same airflow direction
jaw sets slightly as the city becomes legible
per_beat.subtext: Recognition — he has found the gate.

per_beat.core_action: Eases the dive angle and settles into a controlled frontal glide, sword tip angled down toward the gate.
per_beat.intention: Commit to arrival; hand the next shot a stable, legible position.
observable_signals: knees absorb the change of angle, torso rises a few degrees
robe panels settle from full stream to a slower flutter
gaze locked on the gate, chin slightly down
both feet planted, no stepping, no re-balancing scramble

beats.framing: Rear three-quarter long-to-medium shot. Rider and full sword blade in frame from behind and slightly above; cloud deck filling the lower frame; city a distant silhouette.
beats.lens_intent_as_visible_effect: Moderate wide view: the descent reads as fast because cloud and mist streak past the frame edges, and the city stays small enough to feel far away.
beats.principal_camera_move: REAR_CHASE_FOLLOW (tracking follow from behind, matching the subject's descent speed and staying at a constant offset)
beats.end_state_of_move: Camera is still directly behind the rider at a constant offset; the city silhouette has grown but is not yet legible.

beats.framing: Arcs from rear three-quarter through profile to frontal medium shot. Rider and sword remain centred; Thiên Kiếm Thành gate swings into the background behind him.
beats.lens_intent_as_visible_effect: Slightly tighter view as the arc completes, so the face becomes readable at the same moment the city becomes legible.
beats.principal_camera_move: ARC_TO_FRONTAL (single continuous arc from behind to directly in front of the subject, ARC_RIGHT_WITH_ROTATION family)
beats.arc_discipline: The arc is one continuous rotation about the subject. It is not an orbit loop and it does not reverse. It stops exactly at frontal.
beats.camera_move_psychological_verb: reveal / turning to face the audience and the destination at once
beats.end_state_of_move: Camera is exactly frontal, level with the rider's face, at a constant distance; the gate is visible over his shoulder.

beats.framing: Frontal medium shot, rider and sword tip in frame, Thiên Kiếm Thành gate and wall legible behind him.
beats.lens_intent_as_visible_effect: Focus held on the rider with the city readable but softer behind him.
beats.principal_camera_move: LOCKED_OFF_FRONTAL_HOLD (no new principal move; camera matches the subject's residual descent so the frame stays stable)
beats.no_new_move_reason: Adding a third distinct move here would overload the reveal. The hold beat exists to deliver a stable, chainable visible end-state.
beats.focus_discipline: Focus stays locked on the rider through the whole beat. No defocus, no unfinished focus pull.
beats.end_state_of_move: Stable frontal frame; rider centred; sword tip angled down; gate legible behind. This exact frame is the chain handoff.

layer_1_source: High-altitude late-afternoon sun from above and behind the camera's starting position (hard top-rear key on the rider and the blade's upper edge).
Warm lantern, forge, and brazier glow rising from Thiên Kiếm Thành as altitude drops (practical motivated uplight on the city and, at the end, on the rider's underside).
layer_2_behaviour: Hard top-rear key rakes the hair, the shoulder line, and the sword spine; the face is lit by bounce off the cloud deck below during BEAT-01.
Cloud shadow bands sweep across the rider during the descent as he passes through broken cloud.
During the arc the key rotates across his face from rear-rim to three-quarter side light, which is what makes the face readable at frontal.
By BEAT-03 the city uplight is a visible warm rim on the jaw, the robe's underside, and the sword's lower edge.
lighting.layer_3_colour_tone: Colour arc stated once and held: cold blue-grey at altitude, desaturated in the cloud deck, warming to amber-bronze as the city fills the lower frame. The arc progresses with altitude only — it never reverses within the shot.

must_obey: Descent accelerates then holds a terminal rate; the rider is not hovering and not falling at constant zero speed.
Rider weight is visibly carried by the blade: ankles and knees compress, the sword dips a few degrees under load.
Air resistance is continuous: robe, sleeves, sashes, and hair all stream in the same airflow direction with a lag behind body movement.
Cloud and ground parallax are consistent with a fast descent: near mist streaks fast, distant city moves slowly.
Sword flight leaves a short, faint disturbed-air wake; no exhaust, no flame, no engine trail.
Atmospheric perspective increases as altitude drops: the city gains contrast and legibility, the upper sky loses it.
Any detached debris or mist droplets fall behind and upward relative to the descending subject.
must_not_happen: frozen or rubbery cloth and hair
sword bending, warping, or changing length under load
rider's feet sliding off or through the blade
camera clipping through the rider, the sword, or the cloud volume
